children.textContent: delivered for clients of all shapes and sizes over a wide range of sectors.
For almost two decades, we’ve helped businesses across the UK use the web to grow. Whether it’s building a brand, selling products, supporting a charity or raising awareness,
we create websites built around the challenges that matter most.
You’ll work directly with the people creating your website. No account managers. No unnecessary layers. Just experienced designers and developers focused on doing great work.
All of this means that we're able to offer a service that competes with the big guns; yet comes with an affordable price tag.
Great news for you and your project.

Websites shouldn’t need replacing every few years. We build on proven platforms with clean code, scalable content-management and solid technical foundations. Accessibility and sustainability are at the core of every decision, so your investment continues to deliver long after launch.
Bespoke websites without the complexity and cost of a traditional custom build.
Bringing your ideas to life with low development, deployment and maintenance costs.
Perfect for service businesses and product showcases
No job too big or too small.
Low development, maintenance and ownership costs.
SEO and AEO ready from day one.
For organisations with more demanding requirements.
Joined up business systems and applications.
Connects with the software your business relies on everyday.
Turning your ideas into solid digital solutions
A great website is just the beginning. We help businesses make better use of digital technology, from AI automation and search visibility to social media, analytics and connected business systems.
Tell us about your ideas, we'll put our thinking cap on.
Answer a few simple questions about your project. It takes less than a minute. At the end we'll give you an instant estimate.
madewithpixels take basic concepts and create something both beautiful and functional. Through their passion and hard work, the results speak for themselves.

I've had the pleasure of working with Michael and the team at madewithpixels on multiple web design projects over the years, spanning both B2B and B2C. They consistently deliver high-quality work that meets the requirements, and I truly value their pragmatic approach in balancing cost, time, and achieving the desired results. Highly recommended!
Michael is one of the best designers we have used in terms of creativity and understanding of user centred design.

I can honestly say it was a superb experience from start to finish. I will happily recommend madewithpixels to anybody. The site is better than I had hoped it ever would be. Thank-you. It was great working with Michael. Best of all, he managed all of this while finding a way to fit within my budget. Thank you so much Michael! Would 100% recommend.
Michael is a passionate designer with the ability to grasp difficult concepts and translate these into stunning visuals for the web.
The team at madewithpixels made E-commerce look easy. We couldn't be happier with our new site. Great service, great price. Thanks very much!

The team at madewithpixels are responsible for successfully translating our brand aesthetic to the web. After careful consideration of our requirements, they produced a custom-built website which sits proudly alongside our printed magazine. Friendly, approachable and always available, Michael is a versatile designer with a flair for creativity and good eye for what works. Highly recommended.
We have worked with madewithpixels for a number of years, this reflects on their great understanding of our requirements and their hard work in meeting our needs
They provided all of the features we asked for at a price the other design companies we approached couldn't even get close to.
